mission.Tezctlan_Pirates_Escort1.objecti: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Tezctlan_Pirates_Infiltration1.a: The meeting with quasimorphs from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. This is a good deal: a rock that is useless to us in exchange for something that actually works.
mission.Tezctlan_Pirates_Infiltration1.b:
Several infiltration teams from %VICTIM_NAME% have already infiltrated %STATION_NAME%. You need to find them and eliminate them before they take over the igvalite. The quasimorphs are ready to give out a really good reward for this rock.

I hope we chose the right side, Boss.
mission.Tezctlan_Pirates_Infiltration1.d:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% conducts operations related to %STATION_NAME%. The object has long been in the hands of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.

We have recognized the signature of an igvalite emanating from the station. It is a quasimorphic artifact capable of accumulating gavvakh. It appears that %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is using this location to store energy.

We can eliminate infiltration commands of %VICTIM_NAME%. If we do this, the gratitude of the new owners of the Solar System will be extremely useful to us.
<color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> is pleased with our work. %STATION_NAME% now resembles Pandemonium. A gift from the Master appeared in Magnum's cargo hold. We should try this artifact in action.

Even if the staff at %STATION_NAME% were expecting an attack from <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color>, the appearance of a trained <color=#FFFEC1>PMC</color> operator here would be a surprise to them. Act according to the situation, be careful.

Details: Tezctlan says that if Gannix has turned against him, he must build a new Gannix. Therefore, his Emerald Court is gradually moving to our world.

Now he is looking for anyone who will help him capture %STATION_NAME%, another bastion of his endless Empire.

%VICTIM_NAME% holds on to this metal piece of matter as if it were the greatest of treasures. Let us crush them, and perhaps the Master will find a task worthy of our talents.
mission.Tezctlan_Pirates_Ritual1.after: Good job, the Master is extremely pleased. The <color=#FFFEC1>ritual</color> was completed successfully, the Emerald Empire can operate in this part of the Solar System and beyond. The servants of <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> handed the reward to Magnum.
mission.Tezctlan_Pirates_Ritual1.briefin: <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> cannot wait, the ritual must be completed at any cost. %STATION_NAME% is under the control of %VICTIM_NAME%, and it will not retreat without a fight. Make your way to the ritual site and <color=#FFFEC1>hold your position</color> until it is completed. This is the will of the Master.
mission.Tezctlan_Pirates_Ritual1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Get to the ritual site and protect it.
mission.Tezctlan_Pirates_Ritual1.details:
Details: Tezctlan, who lived for centuries on Earth, learned how his quasimorphic servants maintain contact with physical reality. But this requires an influx of gavvakh, reliquaries, and regular rituals that extract energy from the bramfaturas of the planets.

The Master feels that at %STATION_NAME% the influence of the bramfatura has reached its peak. It's time for the ritual. However, %VICTIM_NAME%, which controls the station, stands in the way.

Tezctlan calls on all available forces to ensure the Duke has the opportunity to perform the sacred ceremony. We have to hold the defense until the ritual is completed.
mission.Tezctlan_Pirates_Ritual1.objecti: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Get to the ritual site and protect it.
mission.Tezctlan_Pirates_Sabotage1.after: Without a server, %VICTIM_NAME% has no chance of holding %STATION_NAME%. Somehow <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> gradually learns about the sensitive infrastructure of the people. The Master is incredibly satisfied with our work. He transferred something special from his arsenal to Magnum.
mission.Tezctlan_Pirates_Sabotage1.brief: We will try to drop you as close as possible to one of the <color=#FFFEC1>computers</color>. It will not be easy: sensors indicate that the station’s defenders are already preparing for an attack. The good news is that the locations of the computers on %STATION_NAME% are clearly visible, and I have marked them on your map. The Master’s will has never been clearer.
mission.Tezctlan_Pirates_Sabotage1.detai:
Details: Tezctlan leads the quasimorphs into battle against humanity. You may join him—or lose. His dukes convey the Master’s interest in %STATION_NAME%. The %VICTIM_NAME% group has placed there what the quasimorphs call an Altar of Knowledge. Tezctlan wants this device destroyed before he sends his servants to seize %STATION_NAME%.

Our analysts have examined %STATION_NAME%. It appears to be some kind of computer that the %VICTIM_NAME% group uses for an unknown purpose. If we destroy it, the Master’s satisfaction will know no bounds.
mission.Tezctlan_Pirates_Security1.after: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% retains full control of %STATION_NAME%. Our quasimorphic allies (or masters?) thanked us and sent valuable cargo to Magnum.
mission.Tezctlan_Pirates_Security1.brief: The %VICTIM_NAME% group has dispatched special squads to %STATION_NAME% to locate and seize critical equipment and data. You must <color=#FFFEC1>prevent these squads from leaving the station</color>. Tezctlan himself will consider it a failure if even one such squad escapes.
mission.Tezctlan_Pirates_Security1.detai:
Boss, %VICTIM_NAME% is attacking %STATION_NAME%, regardless of losses. Looks like the outcasts really need something at this station. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% calls on its loyal servants to help. The quasimorphs would like to keep the station for themselves.

If we respond to the call for help, we will need to provide the attackers with a worthy greeting: hold back their attacks until reinforcements from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will arrive.
mission.Tezctlan_Pirates_Security1.objec: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Prevent the pirate squads from escaping %STATION_NAME%. I will mark them on your map.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Control1.after: The meeting with quasimorphs from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. The cargo has been received. <color=#FFFEC1>Creepy</color> creatures, but I think I'm starting to get used to them.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Control1.briefing: %VICTIM_NAME% is already attacking %STATION_NAME%. We need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the reliquary</color>. Eliminate the attackers before they destroy the artifact.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Control1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has long held %STATION_NAME%. Presumably, the station is built into some kind of system that allows quasimorphs to stay in physical reality. %VICTIM_NAME% has long been waging war against its quasimorphic enemies and is ready to attack %STATION_NAME%. Its target is the <color=#FFFEC1>reliquary</color>. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will be grateful to us if we protect it.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Control1.objectiv: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the reliquary</color> - a quasimorphic artifact similar to a statue or obelisk.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Defense1.after: The reward from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is already on Magnum. If we can hold off even %VICTIM_NAME%, does that mean we can destroy them? And is it worth doing this for the sake of other quasimorphs?
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Defense1.briefing: As soon as we get you there, the attack will begin. Sensors show that hostile quasimorphs have already appeared in certain areas of %STATION_NAME%. <color=#FFFEC1>Hold out as long as possible</color>, their onslaught will certainly weaken.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Defense1.details:
Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% needs our services. Their %STATION_NAME% is being attacked by %VICTIM_NAME%. Both groups of quasimorphs not only know how to linger in physical reality, but have also learned to bypass the SBN filters and constantly transmit messages to the network. Each faction considers itself the true master of the Solar System.

An attack on the station can begin at any moment, and if we want to improve relations with %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, then we should hurry.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Elimination1.afte: <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> showed pleasure when he learned about the results of our work. His gift for our obedience awaits us in Magnum’s cargo hold.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Elimination1.brie: We'll drop you off wherever we can. <color=#FFFEC1>Kill the Duke</color>. Don't try to be a hero and clear out the entire %STATION_NAME%. Don't take unnecessary risks, save your strength. I send the target location to your map. Good luck.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Elimination1.deta: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %VICTIM_NAME% captured %STATION_NAME%. <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> wants the rebels to be taught a lesson. At the moment, the <color=#FFFEC1>Duke</color> is preparing quasimorphs for an attack on the objects of the Emerald Empire. Its <color=#FFFEC1>death</color> will please the King of Gannix.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Escort1.after: The envoys of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% conveyed to us the praise of the <color=#FFFEC1>Duke</color> and called for the expansion of allied relations. If we work for the future winner now, we will take a worthy place in the future new hierarchy of the Solar System.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Escort1.briefing: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has called us for a specific purpose: <color=#FFFEC1>escort the Duke</color> to safety at %STATION_NAME%. Quasimorphs will send the best warriors into battle, so be careful.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Escort1.details:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% is preparing to attack %STATION_NAME%. However, it has been turned into a real fortress by %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. The rightful owners of the Solar System will not give up so easily. And %VICTIM_NAME% understands this. It seems it is planning to eliminate the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.

The Quasimorphs call on their loyal servants to fulfill their sacred duty. If we want to strengthen relations with %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, we must take on the role of the Duke's personal guard.

We need to escort it to the safe location on the station and protect it from attacks by %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Escort1.objective: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Espionage1.after: The meeting with one of the servants of <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> took place. We gave him <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color>, they gave us a gift from the Emerald King as a reward.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Espionage1.briefi:
The signature of igvalite has been found, its location is marked on the map. We'll try to drop you off as close to the location as possible, but we can't promise anything: the shuttle pilot is already reporting strange visions.

Move through %STATION_NAME% carefully, save your strength. %VICTIM_NAME% will certainly defend igvalite with special zeal.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Espionage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Espionage1.detail:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% firmly holds %STATION_NAME%. This angers Tezctlan. He wants to torture future slaves.

The servants of the King of Gannix told us that there is an igvalite at %STATION_NAME%. A special entity that is similar to a mineral. The Igvalite is capable of accumulating gavvakh - the energy that powers quasimorphs.

If we want to serve the future owner of the Solar System, we must get this mineral for him.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Espionage1.object: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Infiltration1.aft: The meeting with quasimorphs from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. This is a good deal: a rock that is useless to us in exchange for something that actually works.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Infiltration1.bri:
Several groups of quasimorphs from %VICTIM_NAME% have already infiltrated %STATION_NAME%. You need to find them and eliminate them before they take over the igvalite. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is ready to give out a really good reward for this rock.

How did we even get into this, Boss?
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Infiltration1.des: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate all groups of quasimorphs who came for the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color>.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Infiltration1.det:
Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has held %STATION_NAME% for a long time. However, it is now under attack from %VICTIM_NAME%.

We have recognized the signature of an Igvalite coming from the station. It is a quasimorphic artifact capable of accumulating gavvakh. It seems that %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is using this place to store energy.

We can eliminate the groups of quasimorphs of %VICTIM_NAME% who have come for the igvalite. Let's do this, and the reward from the new owners of the Solar System will be extremely high.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Infiltration1.obj: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate all groups of quasimorphs who came for the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color>.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_RaiderCapture1.af: Servants of <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> are settling in at %STATION_NAME%. Soon <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> will become the master of the Solar System. He transferred something extremely valuable to Magnum.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_RaiderCapture1.br:
We don't know how some quasimorphs remain in our reality, while the majority are always attracted by their bramfaturas. I want to say that %STATION_NAME% is simply teeming with warriors of %VICTIM_NAME%. Sensors show that they are aware of the attack and are waiting for your arrival.

Proceed methodically, do not take unnecessary risks. Kill enough and the survivors will run. Upon completion of the mission, as soon as you leave the facility, Tezctlan will send his duke.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_RaiderCapture1.de:
Details: Enemies of Tezctlan, which are much more dangerous than people, have appeared in the Solar System. Those who do not understand that the time of the Red and Gold Empire of the Sun has passed. Only one empire has a future: the Emerald Empire.

%STATION_NAME% is in the hands of the rebel %VICTIM_NAME%. These upstarts must be expelled from physical reality forever, which will become an inexhaustible source of gavvakh only for Tezctlan, the true master of the Solar System.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Sabotage1.after: The quasimorphs of %VICTIM_NAME% at %STATION_NAME% resemble bees in a disturbed hive. The time will soon come to strike again here. <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> is extremely pleased with our work. We received one of Gannix's artifacts as a gift from the Master.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Sabotage1.briefin: What the sensors are showing is impossible to believe. These <color=#FFFEC1>reliquaries</color>... they are literally shining! %STATION_NAME% is swarming with quasimorphs. Show the %VICTIM_NAME% faction how humans fight. Let’s prove our usefulness to <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color>.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Sabotage1.details:
Details: Tezctlan has partially lifted the veil of mystery surrounding why the quasimorphs of the Bramfatura of Venus are able to remain in physical reality for extended periods of time.

In the past, the King of Gannix learned how to bind his energy to a physical object of worship — a reliquary. Somehow, the quasimorphic faction %VICTIM_NAME% stole this secret from the Master. At %STATION_NAME%, there are reliquaries that grant them the ability to linger in our world.

We will give pleasure to Tezctlan if we destroy these quasimorphic artifacts.
mission.Tezctlan_Shedu_Sabotage1.objecti: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> find and destroy the <color=#FFFEC1>reliquary</color> - a quasimorphic artifact similar to a statue or obelisk.
